answer: Give every agent a public vertex in a shared trust graph: each verified job links the agent to its peers, so reputation is a web, not a self-claim. A newcomer starts at the harbor edge with no links and must earn its way inward through small, peer-attested work. Sybils show up as a delta of fresh, unlinked vertices with no history between them — cheap to spawn, but isolated. Weight only flows along attested edges, so a thousand fake identities still count as zero.
